The surname formed with the help of the suffix -chuk is based on the generalized geographical name osada – in Ukrainian, this was the name of a colony or settlement in foreign lands. A resident of such a settlement could be nicknamed Osadchuk.

The owners of the surname Osadchuk are easiest to meet in Ukraine, especially in Vinnitsa and Zhytomyr. In Russia, most of their namesakes live in the Jewish Autonomous region.

In documents, the surname Osadchuk has been found since the 18th century.
